einzeiler: Cold case fingerprint match links Homer Jackson to four 1980s and 90s murders in Portland
kurzfassung: In 2008, a decades-old fingerprint match led Portland police to suspect Homer Jackson in the 1983 murder of Angela Anderson, eventually connecting him to three other killings of young Black women. Although interrogation recordings and subsequent DNA evidence linked him to multiple scenes, legal challenges over police tactics resulted in his confessions being thrown out. Jackson ultimately avoided trial through an Alford plea to lesser charges and died shortly after completing his sentence, leaving families with unresolved questions.
stichpunkte: A 2008 fingerprint hit from an attic crawlspace connected Homer Jackson to the 1983 murder of 14-year-old Angela Anderson.
Investigators subsequently linked Jackson to the deaths of Tanya Harry, Latanji Watts, and Lawana Triplett through DNA evidence.
Police interrogated Jackson over ten hours across two days, during which he made ambiguous admissions and expressed memory lapses.
The Oregon Supreme Court ultimately suppressed Jackson's interrogation statements, ruling that detectives used improper threats and promises.
Defense lawyers highlighted significant forensic gaps, noting that multiple unidentified DNA profiles and fingerprints were present at every crime scene.
Prosecutors faced separate trials for each victim after judges refused to let the state combine the cases to establish a pattern.
In January 2022, murder charges were dropped when Jackson entered an Alford plea to four counts of criminally negligent homicide.
Jackson was sentenced to time served, was released, and died of natural causes at age 63 in July 2023.

clips.text: The suspect clarifies during questioning that he is merely speculating about how a crime might have happened rather than confirming his own involvement.
Under the terms of the resolution, the defendant accepts a conviction on reduced charges without formally acknowledging commission of the acts.

beschreibung:
In 2008, a single fingerprint from a vacant Portland house linked Homer Lee Jackson III to the 1983 murder of 14-year-old Angela Anderson. Detectives went on to tie him to the deaths of Tonja Harry, Latanga Watts and Lawauna Triplet, and they suspected him in Essie Jackson’s too. But the evidence against him was far less clean than the headlines suggested, and some have wondered whether police actually solved these murders, or just closed them.
If you have any information about Homer Jackson - or the deaths of Essie Jackson, Tonja Harry, Angela Anderson, Latanga Watts or Lawauna Triplet - reach out to our team at tips@audiochuck.com.
